horses.incident_text: Near the 450 Metres was steadied to avoid DRAGON SUNRISE when that horse was checked.  For a short distance thereafter FAMILY FORTUNE raced tight between REWARDING TWINKLE and DRAGON SUNRISE.  J Moreira was fined a sum of $4,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides after the 300 Metres and 3 consecutive strides near the 150 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Raced keenly in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Over the concluding stages lay in, resulting in its rider H Doyle changing her whip to her right hand near the 50 Metres.

M Guyon reported that from a wide barrier he had been instructed to ride his mount in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the intention was to ride SOARING BRONCO in a conservative manner in the early stages preferably midfield but the horse settled further back tonight than anticipated as it was caught wide in the early stages.
Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with STERLING WONGCHOY.

Bumped at the start.  Approaching the 1400 Metres made contact with WINDICATOR FAMILY when that runner was being steadied to avoid STERLING WONGCHOY.  Near the 450 Metres became awkwardly placed behind LUCKY BLESSING as that runner commenced to give ground.  A short distance later DRAGON SUNRISE was then checked to avoid LUCKY BLESSING when attempting to improve to that runner’s outside, resulting in DRAGON SUNRISE shifting out and making contact with WINDICATOR FAMILY, taking that runner wider.  L Hewitson was advised in similar circumstances he should exercise more care.
Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Leaving the 450 Metres made heavy contact with DRAGON SUNRISE when that runner shifted out, resulting in WINDICATOR FAMILY being taken wider.  J McDonald stated that his mount was disadvantaged by having to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and also being heavily bumped near the 450 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  K C Leung reported that whilst the horse was down in class tonight it may not have appreciated carrying the top weight of 135 lbs.  He said, in his view, REWARDING TWINKLE may be better suited by being dropped back in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When giving ground near the 400 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded between STERLING WONGCHOY and TSUEN WAN GLORY which shifted to the outside of PERFECTO MOMENTS to commence a forward move.  M F Poon reported that in the early stages he had to make some use of his mount from his wide barrier to hold a forward position.  He said when BINGO BABE improved to his outside near the 500 Metres LUCKY BLESSING came under pressure and weakened from that point.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LUCKY BLESSING, a last start winner, was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY BLESSING will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

In the early stages raced keenly and got its head up making the first turn.  Leaving the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid NOBLE DELUXE and as a result shifted out and was obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in on jumping and was bumped heavily.  Approaching the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run between ORIENTAL SURPRISE and NOBLE DELUXE, both of which shifted ground slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Near the 250 Metres shifted out to improve and was bumped.

GOOD PROSPECT, which was fractious in the starting gates, jumped awkwardly.  In the early stages of the Home Straight lay in and near the 250 Metres made slight contact with TELECOM POWER when being shifted to the outside of LUCKY GENERATIONS.
No report.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: After the 150 Metres was shifted to the outside of NOBLE DELUXE to continue into clear running.  Over the concluding stages raced tight between NOBLE DELUXE and GOOD PROSPECT.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that TALENTS SUPREMO was lame in its left front leg after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, TALENTS SUPREMO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On jumping bumped heavily with RIDING HIGH and became unbalanced.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
On jumping got its head up and lost ground.  Noted to have lost its left front plate after the race.

Near the 900 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid TALENTS SUPREMO.  Approaching the 400 Metres improved into a narrow run to the inside of MR GOOD VIBES and then became unbalanced when racing tight between PODIUM and MR GOOD VIBES for a short distance thereafter.  Near the 250 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by PODIUM which shifted out to improve.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  M F Poon stated that his mount would be better suited by being stepped back up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped awkwardly.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Near the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of KOLACHI to obtain clear running and made contact with YOUNG BRILLIANT.  When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer K W Lui stated that the horse was advantaged by being dropped back in grade and also the addition of a tongue tie.  He said whilst the horse’s track work had not been impressive he was satisfied with its most recent barrier trial on 13 November 2025.  He added that, in his opinion, the most significant reason for the improved performance was the horse racing at Happy Valley for the first time tonight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Leaving the 250 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of KOLACHI to continue into clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Approaching the 100 Metres improved into a narrow run to the inside of AEROINVINCIBLE.  A short distance later AEROINVINCIBLE then shifted in and away from BULL ATTITUDE, resulting in INCANTO STAR making contact with AEROINVINCIBLE and being crowded for some distance after the 100 Metres. J Orman was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 130 Metres.
No report.
Held up for clear running between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Leaving the 100 Metres shifted in and away from BULL ATTITUDE and became unbalanced when it made contact with INCANTO STAR.
Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Z Purton stated that his mount was able to obtain a position outside the lead as instructed.  He added that in the Home Straight BULL ATTITUDE failed to respond to his riding and was disappointing.  Trainer M Newnham stated that whilst he had requested the horse to be ridden in a forward position, in hindsight it may not have been suited by being ridden in this manner, particularly as it had disappointed previously on 21 September 2025 when ridden in a similar position.  He added that at its next race start he would endeavour to instruct the jockey to ride the horse with cover.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When commencing to give ground near the 150 Metres was eased when racing tight between SUNDAY’S SERENADE and STORMI.
Jumped awkwardly.

Bumped near the 300 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  As this was the second occasion that YOUNG BRILLIANT had bled, the horse is permanently barred from any further racing.
Over the concluding stages lay in and approaching the winning post made contact with BEAUTY THUNDER.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  Bumped near the 250 Metres.  Prior to declaring weighed-in the Stewards gave consideration if there were grounds for a protest/objection against BUNTA BABY being declared the winner due to BEAUTY THUNDER and BUNTA BABY making contact approaching the winning post.  Having regard to the manner in which BUNTA BABY finished the race off and that the contact was due to both runners shifting ground although BUNTA BABY had shifted further, they were satisfied that there were not sufficient grounds to lodge a protest/objection and accordingly declared weighed-in on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Near the 250 Metres shifted in and made slight contact with BEAUTY THUNDER.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Crowded shortly after the start.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind SUPER SIXTY.

Jumped only fairly.  When questioned R Moore stated that in the early stages when positioned to the outside of BUNTA BABY he was obliged to shift in behind that runner when placed in restricted room.  He said throughout the event his mount hung in which he attributed to the horse still being relatively inexperienced.  He added that throughout the middle stages he was obliged to urge his mount to maintain its position at the rear of the field and upon entering the Home Straight he then commenced to shift the horse out to secure clear running.  He said in the Home Straight his efforts to do so were hindered by the horse hanging in and as a result approaching the 100 Metres, when WINNING CHAMPION was commencing to finish the race off, he was obliged to reduce his vigour for a short distance to ensure that he was able to shift to the outside of CAP LINER which was giving ground.  He further stated that once he obtained clear running WINNING CHAMPION finished the race off well under hands and heels riding.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When commencing to give ground near the 150 Metres lay in and was eased to avoid BUNTA BABY which shifted out slightly.
On jumping was crowded for room between HARMONY FIRE which was taken out by BEAUTY THUNDER and SUPER SIXTY which shifted in.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Over the final 200 Metres was held up for clear running and could not be ridden out to the finish.

H Bowman stated that his mount was disadvantaged by being pressured in the lead by SNOWTHORN and as a consequence was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start made contact with YIU CHEUNG VICTORY which shifted in. J Moreira was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 3 consecutive strides near the 200 Metres.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: In the middle stages raced keenly when being steadied to obtain a position to the outside of CORLEONE. <11/12/2025 Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that YOUTH POWER was lame in its right front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, YOUTH POWER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Bumped at the start, shifted in and made contact with QUANTUM PATCH.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, STAR MAC will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
U Rispoli was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height near the 150 Metres..
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Shifted in on jumping and made contact with YIU CHEUNG VICTORY. As a result TAKE ACTION then raced tight to the outside of YIU CHEUNG VICTORY which shifted out slightly.  C Lemaire reported that the intention was to hold a forward position but after being hampered at the start his mount settled further back in the field than intended.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 250 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 550 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of SKY CAP.  Approaching the winning post raced tight between WINNING MONEY and FREE PONY which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly.  Trainer D J Hall confirmed that from the outside barrier he had instructed J McDonald to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  After being shifted to the inside of ARGENTO OCEAN near the 150 Metres then was held up over the final 100 Metres when racing tight to the inside of ARGENTO OCEAN which shifted in and when positioned close to the heels of WINNING MONEY.
Shifted out near the 250 Metres and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of H Doyle, 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, she was nonetheless reminded of her obligation to ensure that she fully rides her mounts out to the finish of the race.
No report.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 550 Metres made contact with the running rail when racing tight to the inside of FLYING WROTE.

Between the 800 Metres and the 600 Metres SKY CAP, which was racing keenly, was steadied to avoid SAVVY TWINKLE (H Doyle) which shifted in when not quite clear and then steadied the pace for some distance thereafter.  H Doyle was severely reprimanded and advised she must ensure that she is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  Bumped near the 250 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by WINNING MONEY which shifted out slightly.  Bumped approaching the 250 Metres.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Approaching the 250 Metres ARGENTO OCEAN improved to the outside of SAVVY TWINKLE.  A short distance later SAVVY TWINKLE shifted out slightly, resulting in ARGENTO OCEAN shifting out and making contact with SKY CAP, causing SKY CAP to be taken out and WATCH THIS ONE and FLYING WROTE to be taken wider.  At the same point FREE PONY was being shifted to the outside of FLYING WROTE and as a consequence was taken wider, resulting in WAVE GARDEN having to be steadied when crowded between WIN METHOD and FREE PONY.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped on jumping.  When questioned regarding his riding over the concluding stages Z Purton stated that in the Home Straight his mount hung in.  He said as he approached the finish of the event he heard a call from a rider to his inside and as a consequence he looked in, stopped riding and straightened his mount as he was concerned FLYING FORTRESS was shifting in, crowding runners to his inside.   Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with ANOTHER ZONDA.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
At the finish of the race H Doyle was obliged to stop riding and straighten her mount when it shifted in towards HIGHLAND RAHY.
No report.
Bumped on jumping.  Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres was held up for clear running between HIGHLAND RAHY and SAMARKAND.

J Moreira was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 300 Metres and 2 consecutive strides near the 200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
In the middle stages raced keenly in the lead and approaching the 1000 Metres got its head up when being steadied.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and bumped VIVA GRACIOUSNESS.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Over the final 50 Metres could not be ridden out when held up between BEAUTY GLORY and ANOTHER ZONDA.  M Barzalona reported that his mount hung in throughout the event and proved difficult to ride out in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Made contact with the left side of its starting gate on jumping and shortly after shifted out and made contact with FLYING FORTRESS.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped at the start.  Near the 900 Metres got its head up when racing ungenerously and being steadied to obtain cover behind IVY LEAGUE.  W Buick reported that his instructions were to obtain a midfield position.  He said from the 600 Metres VIVA GRACIOUSNESS was under pressure and then gave ground thereafter.
Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between WONDERSTAR and MIGHTY COMMANDER, both of which shifted ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
On jumping was crowded by AKASHVANI which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Held up making the Home Turn.
Bumped at the start.  In the Home Straight lay in and near the 150 Metres H Doyle was obliged to stop riding and straighten her mount when it shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.  (see General)

Crowded shortly after the start.  Approaching the 1000 Metres was eased when being crossed by TOURBILLON GOLFER which shifted in.  In the middle stages raced keenly and near the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied away from AKASHVANI.  (see General)
After travelling a short distance was steadied to avoid PAKISTAN LEGACY which shifted out.  Near the 350 Metres was steadied when racing in restricted room between ROMANTIC SON and TRIUMPHANT MORE.
Over the final 50 Metres could not be fully ridden out when placed in restricted room between TRIUMPHANT MORE and TOURBILLON GOLFER, both of which shifted ground.  (see General)
Bumped shortly after the start.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Over the final 100 Metres was held up for clear running behind MR DESIRA and could not be ridden out to the finish.

horses.incident_text: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 150 Metres and the 50 Metres was held up behind WONDERSTAR. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <11/12/2025 Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, KYRUS DRAGON was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. KYRUS DRAGON was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D J Hall this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg. Before being allowed to race again, KYRUS DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped at the start. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. (see General)

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  M Barzalona stated that in the early stages his mount raced keenly and making the first turn got its head up and ran wide.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Leaving the 100 Metres was steadied when crowded between KEEFY which shifted in and away from SPEED DRAGON and SKY HEART (U Rispoli) which shifted out slightly.  U Rispoli was advised to exercise more care.
